battle.name: 柏鄉之戰
battle.theater: 河北邢台柏鄉野河一帶
battle.brief: 開平四年（910）十月，朱溫以救王鎔、討劉守光為名深入河北；王鎔轉求晉王李存勖，晉軍出井陘屯趙州，會戰柏鄉野河。晉軍步兵結方陣抵住梁軍騎兵衝擊，周德威率精騎斜擊梁軍陣腳，梁軍崩潰，河北門戶洞開。卡面斯巴達長矛屬古希臘重步兵兵器，未在此役；對應者為王彥章的長槊，一樣以刺突定勝負。

kit.name: 斯巴達長矛
kit.history: 兩米長的木槍，槍尾帶銅套。方陣裡它比劍更早決定誰站得住。

countries: 柏鄉之戰是開平四年（910）十月後梁與河東晉軍在河北中南部的第一次主力會戰，交戰的兩大陣營分別以汴州與太原為本營。梁軍名義上由皇帝朱溫親領中央禁軍與北衙各軍，實際上由北面招討使王彥章節制，骨幹是自滑州、魏州、汴州、宋州等方鎮抽調的兵，騎兵比例高，攜帶大量輜重。朱溫此番用兵有明確的政治目的：趁河朔三鎮不寧，以救援成德軍節度使王鎔、討伐幽州劉守光為名，把宣武軍的編制推過太行山，納入河北的稅賦與兵源。晉軍方面以晉王李存勖為總指揮，兵員來自河東沙陀騎兵、昭義軍、振武軍與河中、雄勝等藩鎮，外線另有義成軍節度使王處直與成德軍節度使王鎔的部眾，駐地正在趙州與柏鄉之間。梁軍的藉口對象劉守光此時已與其父劉仁恭父子失和，幽州實際由劉守光掌握，是河北最不安分的一支。兩邊指揮體系的長處與短處一目了然：梁軍遠來，序列長，號令出自汴州，糧道橫跨黃河與河北運道；晉軍據地迎戰，本地嚮導、柴芻與馬匹補充可在數日之內完成，而河北諸鎮在兩者之間觀望，誰贏誰就多一分安全感。
countriesEn: The battle of Baixiang was the first major engagement between the Later Liang and the army of the Jin of Hedong in the middle and south of Hebei, fought in the tenth month of the fourth year of Kaitai (910), the two camps based at Bianzhou and at Taiyuan respectively. On the Liang side the army was nominally led by the emperor Zhu Wen with the central guards and the divisions of the Northern Commands, but in practice it was commanded by the northern commander Wang Yanzhang, its backbone being troops drawn from the circuits of Huazhou, Weizhou, Bianzhou and Songzhou, with a high proportion of cavalry and a great train of baggage. Zhu Wen had a clear political purpose in this campaign: taking advantage of the disorder among the three circuits of Hebei, and marching under the pretext of relieving the military governor of Chengde, Wang Rong, and punishing Liu Shouguang at Youzhou, so as to push the Xuanwu system past the Taihang and draw in the taxes and the manpower of Hebei. The Jin side was commanded by the Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu, with men from the Shatuo cavalry of Hedong, the Zhaoyi Army, the Zhenwu Army and such circuits as Hezhong and Xiongsheng, and on the outer line the troops of Wang Chuzhi, governor of the Yicheng Army, and of Wang Rong, governor of the Chengde Army, the whole force posted between Zhaozhou and Baixiang. The pretext for the Liang march, Liu Shouguang, had by then fallen out with his father Liu Rengong, and Youzhou was in fact in his own hands; he was the most unsettled force in Hebei. The strengths and the weaknesses of the two command systems were plain: the Liang army came from far away, its column was long, its orders came from Bian, and its supply line crossed both the Yellow River and the transport roads of Hebei; the Jin army fought on its own ground, where guides, fodder and remounts could be found within a few days, and the circuits of Hebei watched from the side, taking whichever side won as the safer one.
people: 本役的關鍵人物，一邊是梁廷的決策者與主將，一邊是晉軍的宿將。梁太祖朱溫是這場戰爭的始作俑者：他在唐末掃平河南，904年逼唐昭宗遷都後弒之，907年迫唐哀帝禪位建立後梁，此後一心要吞併河朔三鎮，柏鄉之戰就是他兼併政策的第一次硬碰硬，兵鋒曾抵深州、冀州，逼近成德軍治所鎮州。北面招討使王彥章是梁最能打的柱石，出身都虞候，綽號王鐵槍，善使長槊、能挽重弓，全軍鋒銳之所聚；本役他率滑、魏、汴、宋之眾北上，駐紮柏鄉，兵敗退保之後仍為梁廷倚重，至923年中都之戰兵敗被俘，堅拒不降，終被斬於市。晉王李存勖是李克用之子，908年嗣位晉王，尚未稱帝，本役親自率軍出井陘、屯趙州，是全軍的決策核心；昭義軍節度使周德威以精騎斜擊梁軍陣腳，是扭轉戰局的那一擊；振武軍節度使符存審出身契丹部族，與李存勖結為兄弟，與李嗣源同為前鋒健將；李嗣源自潞州騎卒起家，是李存勖最倚重的騎將，十六年後正是他夜渡汶水擒王彥章。河北方面，成德軍節度使王鎔與義成軍節度使王處直在梁軍逼近時轉向晉王求援，自此把河北的存亡押在河東一邊。
peopleEn: The decisive figures of this battle were on both sides, the makers of Liang policy and their generals on one, the veteran commanders of the Jin on the other. The founder of the Later Liang, Zhu Wen, was the author of the war: he swept the central plain at the end of the Tang, in 904 forced the Tang emperor Zhaozong to move the capital and then killed him, in 907 compelled the Tang emperor Ai to abdicate and founded the Later Liang, and from then on set his heart on swallowing the three circuits of Hebei; the battle of Baixiang was the first time that policy met a hard obstacle, his advanced guard reaching Shenzhou and Jizhou and pressing close to Zhenzhou, the seat of the Chengde Army. The northern commander Wang Yanzhang was the strongest pillar of the Liang army, a man who had come up through the duhou ranks, nicknamed the iron spear, skilled with the long spear and able to draw a heavy bow, the point on which the whole sharpness of the army was gathered; in this campaign he led the men of Huazhou, Weizhou, Bianzhou and Songzhou northward and encamped at Baixiang, and after the defeat and the withdrawal he was still leaned on by the Liang court, until in 923 he met the Tang army at Zhongdu, was taken prisoner, refused to submit and was beheaded in the market. The Prince of Jin, Li Cunxu, was the son of Li Keyong and had succeeded as Prince of Jin in 908 without yet claiming the throne; in this campaign he led the army out through Jingxing and posted it at Zhaozhou himself, and was the decision-making core of the whole force. Zhou Dewei, military governor of the Zhaoyi Army, struck the flank of the Liang line with picked horse and gave the battle its turn. Fu Cunshen, military governor of the Zhenwu Army, came of a Khitan clan, had become a sworn brother of Li Cunxu, and together with Li Siyuan was one of the leading vanguards. Li Siyuan, who began as a trooper out of Luzhou, was the mounted commander the Prince of Jin trusted most; sixteen years later it was he who crossed the Wenshui by night and took Wang Yanzhang. On the Hebei side, the military governor of Chengde, Wang Rong, and the military governor of Yicheng, Wang Chuzhi, turned to the Prince of Jin for help as the Liang army closed in, and from that day put the fate of Hebei in the hands of Hedong.
kits: 卡面上這柄斯巴達長矛是公元前五世紀的希臘重步兵兵器：本色木杆，長約兩米上下，前端安葉形青銅矛頭，杆尾另包銅套並留出可以插入地面的鐏段，握法是右手在前、左手在後，與圓盾相配，密集隊形中以平推刺出而非揮砍，落後者以盾沿頂住前排的背。它在本卡的位置是一柄等價物，用來標示同一套冷兵器邏輯：兩米上下的長兵、雙手持握、以刺定生死，並在方陣中與盾共同構成整體防線。本役現場並沒有這件兵器；河北的中原兵馬用的是唐兵制的長槊與馬槊，鐵刃安在長杆上，構造與鐏套相近，晉軍騎兵以馬槊衝鋒時正是平推而非要砍；王彥章的鐵槍更是史載其名的招牌裝備。除長兵之外，雙方通用的還有環首刀與橫刀、臂弩與蹶張弩、弓箭與標槍，防守用大盾、拒馬與蒺藜，攻城用雲梯、飛樓、衝車與拋車，野戰真正決定勝負的裝備則是馬匹、糧車與浮橋渡口。對照兩套系統：希臘重步兵靠方陣正面硬頂，本役的晉軍同樣先以步兵結方陣抵住梁軍騎兵衝擊，只是取勝的一擊來自翼側的騎兵。
kitsEn: The dory on the card is a weapon of the Greek heavy infantry of the fifth century BC: a plain wooden shaft about two metres long, with a leaf-shaped bronze blade at the front, and at the butt a bronze ferrule with a length of ferrule that could be planted in the ground; it was gripped with the right hand forward and the left behind, it went with the round shield, and in a dense formation it was used by pushing the point level rather than by swinging, the rear rank bracing the front rank with the rim of the shield. In this card its position is that of an equivalent object, used to mark the same logic of cold weapons: a two-metre long weapon held in both hands, life and death decided by the thrust, and, in the phalanx, a single line of defence made jointly with the shields. The weapon itself was never present in this campaign. The troops of the central plain in Hebei used the long spear and the mounted spear of the Tang arming system, with an iron blade set on a long shaft, built much like the ferrule and the socket, and when the Jin cavalry charged with the mounted spear they pushed it level rather than swung it down; the iron spear of Wang Yanzhang was a weapon famed in the record itself. Besides the long weapons, both sides used the ring-pommel sabre and the hengdao, the drawn bow and the arm crossbow and the stretching crossbow, arrows and javelins; for defence there were large shields, the juma obstacle and caltrops; for siege, scaling ladders, flying towers, battering rams and trebuchets; and the equipment that truly decided the field battle was the horse, the grain wagon and the pontoon crossing. Set the two systems side by side: the Greek heavy infantry held the line with the front of the phalanx, and the Jin here likewise met the first Liang charge with a phalanx of foot, the difference being that the blow that won the day came from the horse on the flank.
tactics: 兩軍的戰術各自成形，而分出勝負的那一步落在騎兵翼側。梁軍的部署是典型的遠征樣子：自汴州出發，夾道自黃河南岸北上，師出有名所以沿途無阻，進抵柏鄉即擇水草與地勢紮營，前鋒銜接極快，騎兵多、打得開；代價是序列長、糧道長，士卒久役而援兵未至，一場敗仗就足以讓全軍鬆散。晉軍是據地迎戰：先出井陘、屯趙州，再前推至柏鄉與野河一線，利用太行山東麓的丘陵與河曲遮蔽列陣，等梁軍前鋒疲憊才發動反擊。關鍵在第一回合的處理——晉軍以步兵結成方陣迎住梁軍的騎兵衝擊，盾密排、長槊前指，把衝勢吃掉；待梁軍攻勢稍挫，昭義軍精騎由陣翼斜插梁軍陣腳，騎兵以長槊平推切入缺口，把被方陣黏住的騎兵衝散，隨後縱騎窮追，截斷其輜重大道。經此一役，梁軍退回漳河南岸，河北門戶洞開。柏鄉的德勝關與野河一段的隘路地形，是雙方都必須爭奪的節點：卡面上的斯巴達方陣與此處的步兵方陣在結構上同構，都是以整體而非個人承擔衝擊。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the two armies were each formed in their own way, but the step that decided the result fell to the horse on the flank. The Liang deployment was that of a typical expedition: it set out from Bianzhou and marched north in a column along the south bank of the Yellow River, and because it had a good pretext it met no obstacle on the way; on reaching Baixiang it chose its camp by water, grass and the shape of the ground, the vanguard closed up with great speed, and with many riders it could spread out and fight. The cost was a long column and a long supply line: the men had been on the march a long time and the reinforcements had not come, and a single defeat was enough to loosen the whole army. The Jin fought on their own ground: they went out through Jingxing, held Zhaozhou, then pushed forward to the line of Baixiang and the Yehe river, using the hills and the bends of the stream on the eastern foot of the Taihang to screen their deployment, and waited for the Liang vanguard to tire before striking back. The crux lay in the first exchange: the Jin formed their foot into a square to receive the Liang cavalry charge, shields ranked close and long spears levelled, and swallowed up the momentum of the charge; only when the Liang attack had spent itself did the picked horse of the Zhaoyi Army drive obliquely into the foot of the Liang line, the riders pushing their long spears level into the gap and scattering the horse that the square had stuck, and then they pursued at full stretch and cut the road of the baggage train. After this action the Liang fell back to the south bank of the Zhang River and the door of Hebei stood open. The defile at Desheng and the stretch of the Yehe river near Baixiang were a point both sides had to fight for: the Spartan phalanx on the card and the square of foot here are structurally the same thing, both making the whole, rather than the individual, bear the shock.
data: 可核對的數字集中在年表與兩處兵力記錄上。年表一線：907年四月朱溫迫唐哀帝禪位建梁；908年李克用病死、李存勖嗣晉王；910年十月柏鄉之役，晉軍殲滅梁軍二萬餘，梁軍退回漳河南岸；911年劉守光稱帝建燕；912年朱溫被次子朱友珪所弒；915年劉鄩以六萬兵接管魏博、魏州兵變；916年二月魏州之役劉鄩部全滅；917年契丹南伐幽州；918年夾河對峙百餘日；923年後梁亡。戰役本身：開平四年十月，晉梁在柏鄉北野河一線大戰，歷時數日到數旬不等，亦有從十月跨到次年正月的拉鋸記載。距離與地名：柏鄉在趙州之西、邢州之東，處太行山東麓、漳河與滏水之間，自趙州出發一日騎程可達；德勝關一線是河北南下太行的隘口。損耗上最常見的引述是梁軍二萬餘被殲、輜重器械盡失。須說明的是，本役的兵員番數多不可考：《資治通鑑》與《舊五代史》《新五代史》一系只給出全破、二萬餘一類概數，具體編制難以核實，本卡因此不列精確番數，也沒有可信的雙方總兵力記載可以對照。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked sit in the chronology and in two records of strength. The chronology runs: in the fourth month of 907 Zhu Wen compelled the Tang emperor Ai to abdicate and founded the Liang; in 908 Li Keyong died of illness and Li Cunxu succeeded as Prince of Jin; in the tenth month of 910 came the battle of Baixiang, in which the Jin destroyed more than twenty thousand Liang troops and the Liang fell back to the south bank of the Zhang River; in 911 Liu Shouguang proclaimed himself emperor of Yan; in 912 Zhu Wen was killed by his second son Zhu Yougui; in 915 Liu Cun took sixty thousand men into Weibo and the soldiers of Weizhou mutinied; in the second month of 916 the battle of Weizhou destroyed the army of Liu Cun; in 917 the Khitan marched south against Youzhou; in 918 the two sides faced one another across the Jiahe for more than a hundred days; in 923 the Later Liang perished. The battle itself: in the tenth month of the fourth year of Kaitai the Jin and the Liang fought along the Yehe river north of Baixiang, over a period of several days to several tens of days, and there are also records of a seesaw that ran from the tenth month into the first month of the following year. As for distance and place names: Baixiang lies west of Zhaozhou and east of Xingzhou, at the eastern foot of the Taihang between the Zhang River and the Fu river, a day's ride from Zhaozhou; the line of Desheng is the defile by which an army comes south out of Hebei toward the Taihang. On losses the most commonly quoted figure is that more than twenty thousand Liang troops were destroyed and that the baggage and engines were all lost. It should be said that the strength of the armies in this battle is largely beyond verification: the Zizhi Tongjian and the histories of the Five Dynasties give only such generalities as wholly broken and more than twenty thousand, the exact establishment cannot be checked, and this card therefore lists no precise numbers of men, nor is there any reliable record of the total strength of either side to set against the other.
cause: 打起來有四層原因。最外層是朱溫的兼併計劃：後梁要在中原之外拿到河北的稅賦與兵源，就必須把成德、義成、盧龍三鎮收進宣武軍的體系，開平四年他以救王鎔、討劉守光為名大軍北上，兵鋒抵深州、冀州、逼近鎮州城下，等於直接向成德軍亮出吞併的刀鋒，王鎔與王處直因此轉向河東求援，這才有了柏鄉之戰。第二層是晉軍的戰略取向：河北若落入梁手，河東晉就只剩太行山一道屏障，晉王李存勖必須把戰線推到河北境內，讓梁軍的河北通道無法開通。第三層是地理與物資：梁軍自汴州遠來，糧道橫穿河北運道，一旦在柏鄉受挫，後方接應與軍心同時出問題；晉軍則有趙州、深州的在地支持，騎兵補充與嚮導都不缺。第四層是梁廷內部的裂縫：朱溫晚年多疑，諸子與諸將各懷算計，遠在河北的北面招討使只能獨自承擔一場必須速決的戰事，而劉守光一方只想保住幽州，援軍一到能否死戰到底，本身就是疑問。戰爭的勝負因此不只取決於兵數，也取決於誰更能在陌生的河北把糧線與指揮維持下去。
causeEn: There were four layers behind the fighting. The outermost was the annexation policy of Zhu Wen: if the Later Liang was to draw the taxes and the manpower of Hebei it had to fold the three circuits of Chengde, Yicheng and Lulong into the Xuanwu system, and in the fourth year of Kaitai he marched a great army north under the pretext of relieving Wang Rong and punishing Liu Shouguang, his advanced guard reaching Shenzhou and Jizhou and pressing to the walls of Zhenzhou. That was the annexation blade shown openly to the Chengde Army, and Wang Rong and Wang Chuzhi accordingly turned to Hedong for help, which is what brought on the battle of Baixiang. The second layer was the strategic orientation of the Jin: if Hebei fell to the Liang, the Jin of Hedong would have nothing left but the Taihang as a barrier, and the Prince of Jin had to push the line into Hebei so that the Liang could never open the northern door. The third layer was geography and supply: the Liang army came from far away at Bian, and its supply line ran across the transport roads of Hebei, so a check at Baixiang would tell on the rear services and on the morale of the men at the same time; the Jin, for their part, had the support of Zhaozhou and Shenzhou on the spot, and neither remounts nor guides were lacking. The fourth layer was the fissure inside the Liang court: Zhu Wen in his last years was suspicious and jealous, his sons and his generals each had their own calculations, and the northern commander far away in Hebei had to carry alone a battle that had to be won quickly; and the Liu Shouguang side wanted nothing more than to keep Youzhou, so whether the relieving army would fight to the death once it arrived was itself in doubt. The result of the war therefore turned not only on the number of men, but on who could keep a supply line and a chain of command working in an unfamiliar Hebei.
impact: 柏鄉之戰的直接後果是河北的門戶被打開。梁軍退回漳河南岸，成德軍節度使王鎔從此完全倒向晉軍，義成軍王處直隨之，河朔三鎮在往後十三年裡陸續靠向河東，河北對中原王朝而言第一次從外藩變成可以整合的地盤。連帶的是幽州：劉守光失去了唯一的外援，911年稱帝建燕已無喘息，兩三年內即為晉軍所擒殺，盧龍軍重新回到中原控制之下。再往遠看，梁廷在河北方面的機動力量被打散，遂把兵鋒轉向北面的潞州，911年起圍攻上黨，一場長達數年的上黨之戰把晉梁的最後攤牌提前；那一役之後，梁失去河北屏障，晉失去北面的依托，十六年後923年李存勖滅梁只是順勢收尾。技術層面的收穫更值得留意：步兵結方陣抵住騎兵衝擊，再以翼側精騎斜擊扭轉戰局，這套打法在唐末五代被反覆使用，成為中原步兵對抗北方騎兵時最成熟的答案。卡面上的斯巴達長矛則是一個旁證：同一個十年裡，希臘重步兵靠方陣與長矛在歐洲內戰中爭地盤，東亞的騎兵則靠翼側的一擊決定河北的歸屬，兩套邏輯此時各行其是，互不往來。
impactEn: The direct consequence of the battle of Baixiang was that the door of Hebei was opened. The Liang army fell back to the south bank of the Zhang River, the military governor of Chengde, Wang Rong, turned wholly to the Jin, and Wang Chuzhi of the Yicheng Army followed him; the three circuits of Hebei drew over the following thirteen years one by one to Hedong, and for the central plains dynasties Hebei changed for the first time from an outlying frontier into a territory that could be absorbed. The knock-on effect fell on Youzhou: Liu Shouguang had lost his only outside support, his proclamation of the empire of Yan in 911 left him no breathing room, and within two or three years he was taken and killed by the Jin, and the Lulong Army came back under central plains control. Looking further ahead, the mobile strength of the Liang in Hebei was broken up, and the Liang turned its edge northward to Luzhou, besieging Shangdang from 911, and that long war of Shangdang brought the final reckoning between the two houses forward in time; after it the Liang had lost its shield in Hebei and the Jin its anchor in the north, and the destruction of the Liang by Li Cunxu in 923 was only the gathering of a tide. The technical gain deserves attention too: foot formed into a square to absorb a cavalry charge and then picked horse driven in from the flank to turn the battle. This method was used again and again in the late Tang and the Five Dynasties and became the most mature answer of the central plains infantry to the cavalry of the north. The Spartan dory on the card is a piece of corroboration: in the same decade the Greek heavy infantry were fighting for ground in the civil wars of Europe with phalanx and long spear, while the cavalry of East Asia decided the ownership of Hebei with a single stroke on the flank, and the two logics at that moment went each its own way without ever meeting.
result: 打點完，柏鄉歸晉，梁軍退回漳河南岸，河北門戶洞開。開平四年十月的野河一戰，晉軍以步兵方陣吃掉梁軍的第一次騎兵衝擊，再由周德威的昭義軍精騎斜插梁軍陣腳，梁軍崩潰，被殲二萬餘，輜重器械盡為晉軍所獲；王鎔、王處直的成德、義成兩軍自此與梁絕裂，河北的兵源、稅賦與城邑盡數倒向河東。這場戰爭沒有直接結束梁晉對抗：梁廷仍以王彥章等名將固守德勝、楊劉一線，911年轉而北攻潞州，916年魏州之役、918年夾河對峙，一路由916年拖到923年才由李存勖自楊劉渡河、取中都、俘王彥章、下汴州而定局。但柏鄉是把河北從梁的棋盤上拿走的關鍵一手，後來所有的勝負都建立在這個前提上。卡面的斯巴達長矛從未出現在河北，它留在這張卡上是作為等價物：真正決定柏鄉歸屬的，既不是任何一柄矛的形制，也不是任何一隊步卒的方陣，而是兩翼的騎兵和背後那條跨河北運河的糧道。
resultEn: When it was over, Baixiang was Jin territory, the Liang army had fallen back to the south bank of the Zhang River, and the door of Hebei stood open. In the fighting on the Yehe river in the tenth month of the fourth year of Kaitai, the Jin swallowed the first Liang charge with a square of foot, and then the picked horse of Zhou Dewei's Zhaoyi Army drove obliquely into the foot of the Liang line; the Liang broke, more than twenty thousand were destroyed, and the baggage and engines all fell to the Jin. The Chengde and Yicheng armies of Wang Rong and Wang Chuzhi from that moment broke with the Liang, and the manpower, the taxes and the cities of Hebei went over to Hedong in full. The war did not end here: the Liang court still held the line at Desheng and Yangliu with such commanders as Wang Yanzhang, turned north to attack Luzhou in 911, and the business dragged on through the battle of Weizhou in 916 and the stalemate across the Jiahe in 918, until Li Cunxu crossed at Yangliu, took Zhongdu, captured Wang Yanzhang and came down upon Bian in 923. But Baixiang was the move that took Hebei off the board of the Liang, and every later success or failure was built on that premise. The Spartan dory never came to Hebei; it stays on the card as an equivalent object, and what really decided the ownership of Baixiang was neither the shape of any spear nor the square of any body of foot, but the horse on the two flanks and the supply line behind them that crossed the rivers of Hebei.
